ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a transition-state structure; on the left side there is a five-membered ring/acetal-like fragment containing two oxygen atoms, and the two carbons on the left are respectively connected to R and R¹; the central carbon on the right side is connected to S, and S is then connected to P(OMe)3 with a positive-charge label. There are also negative charge, positive charge, and curved arrows in the figure; these are not counted as chemical bonds. Then reason: according to the question meaning, exclude all bonds involving hydrogen, and ignore arrows and charge symbols. The non-hydrogen bonds of the left ring and substituent part are: R-C, C-C, C-R¹, upper C-O, lower C-O, upper O-central C, lower O-central C, a total of 7. The central C-S bond is 1, and the S-P bond is 1. (OMe)3 is expanded as 3 P-O bonds and 3 O-C bonds in O-Me, a total of 6. Total = 7 + 1 + 1 + 6 = 15.

method.method_draft: Make a bond ledger from the image. Count the non-H bonds in the left ring/substituent portion: R-C, C-C, C-R1, C-O(top), C-O(bottom), O-C(top to central), and O-C(bottom to central) = 7. Add the central C-S bond = 1 and the S-P bond = 1. Expand (OMe)3 as three P-O-Me units, giving 3 P-O bonds plus 3 O-Me bonds = 6. Ignore the curved arrow and charge symbols. Total: 7 + 1 + 1 + 6 = 15.

再推理：按题意排除所有涉及氢的键，并忽略箭头和电荷符号。左侧环和取代基部分的非氢键为：R-C、C-C、C-R¹、上方 C-O、下方 C-O、上方 O-中心 C、下方 O-中心 C，共 7 个。中心 C-S 键为 1 个，S-P 键为 1 个。(OMe)3 展开为 3 个 P-O 键和 3 个 O-Me 中的 O-C 键，共 6 个。总数 = 7 + 1 + 1 + 6 = 15。

method.method_draft: Partition the image into fragments and count by fragment. The left heterocycle contributes its five ring bonds. The two substituent attachments to R and R1 add 2 bonds. Total: 5 + 2 + 2 + 6 = 15.
